note_en: 即使…也… means "even if / even though…, still…": 即使主唱已经去世很多年，歌迷也仍然记得Beyond的音乐 "even though the lead singer died many years ago, fans still remember Beyond's music." Note that 也 must come after the subject of the second clause (歌迷也…), never before it, unlike English "still," which can move around more freely. The pattern can describe a hypothetical or, as here, a real situation.
